name: EPIC 246002196
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 8.0 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,608 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.85 solar masses and 8.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,799 K at its surface.
